title: Buffalo Shredded Chicken Baked Potato
description: Baked russet topped with Buffalo shredded chicken and cheese. Microwave potato = 15 min; oven potato = about 1 hour.

ingredients.item: sour cream; ranch or blue cheese

steps: Bake 1 large russet (R15). Microwave shortcut is fine for a work night.
Warm about 1 cup shredded chicken in the microwave, covered, 1 to 2 min. Toss with 2 to 3 Tbsp Buffalo sauce (R8).
Split the potato, fluff, add butter and salt.
Pile on the Buffalo chicken, top with shredded mozzarella or habanero jack.
Microwave 30 to 45 sec (or Air Fry mode 425°F for 3 to 5 min) to melt the cheese.
Top with sour cream and a drizzle of ranch or blue cheese. Optional: broccoli on the side (R16).
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R23

healthy: Potato gives potassium and fiber, especially with the skin.
not_healthy: Buffalo sauce and salt add sodium.
Butter, cheese, sour cream and ranch or blue cheese add saturated fat.
